Courses may be offered in person on Concord University’s main campus in Athens, WV, and/or online, depending on departmental needs.. Applicants must hold a master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, or a closely related field. Duties and Responsibilities Duty/Responsibility To perform this role successfully, an individual should be able to: Prepare and deliver instruction in introductory mathematics courses in alignment with the established course map, in both in‑person and online formats. Develop and maintain course materials, including syllabi, assignments, and supplemental instructional resources. Assess student learning through assignments, tests, and other evaluations, grading fairly and consistently, and providing timely feedback to support student progress. Contribute to General Education Assessment by collecting, documenting, and reporting required course data. Maintain regular office hours to provide academic support, assist with course‑related questions, and contribute to student recruitment and retention efforts. Keep accurate records of attendance, grades, and other required documentation in compliance with federal FERPA regulations. Perform additional duties as assigned by the Department Chair or Dean. % of Time 100 Education/Knowledge Minimum Education Master's Required Licenses/Certification Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, or a closely related field. Required Skills Solid understanding of introductory mathematics, including quantitative reasoning, algebra, and statistics Strong teaching and communication skills, with the ability to explain concepts clearly to a wide range of learners Ability to create a supportive and engaging learning environment Skill in developing instructional materials and using effective teaching strategies Proficiency with learning management systems and basic instructional technology Strong organizational abilities, including timely grading, accurate record‑keeping, and adherence to academic policies Ability to work effectively with faculty, staff, and students Commitment to Concord University’s mission and to supporting student success in foundational coursework Required Experience Type of experience Needed Experience teaching Quantitative Reasoning, College Algebra, and/or Elementary Statistics preferred Amount of Experience Needed (Months/Years) More than 2 years Posting Detail Information Close Date Open Until Filled Yes Additional Information Requirements for Completed Application.- Letter of application- CV- Unofficial copy of transcripts (The selected candidate will be required to submit official copies of transcripts before time of appointment- Three references and their contact information (including a current address, phone number and e-mail address) Quick Link to Posting https://jobs.concord.edu/postings/1602 Posting Supplemental Questions Required fields are indicated with an asterisk (*).
